newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: APN says in exhibitions joint venture.
newsitem.headline: APN says in exhibitions joint venture.

text.p: Regional newspaper proprietor Australian Provincial Newspapers Holdings Ltd (APN) said on Tuesday it has joined with exhibition company Miller Freeman to form APN/Miller Freeman Exhibitions Pty Ltd in Australia.
The 50/50 joint venture plans to initiate and conduct trade fairs, exhibitions, conferences and seminars in Australia and New Zealand.
Miller Freeman, a subsidiary of Britain's United News and Media Plc, has extensive business-to-business publishing and trade fair operations in Europe, the U.S. and Asia, APN said.
APN is Australia's largest regional newspaper owner, publishing more than 60 newspapers.
